annotation.title_clean: ISO 5015-2:2022 Unmanned aircraft systems — Part 2: Operation of vertiports for vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) unmanned aircraft (UA)
annotation.title_en: ISO 5015-2:2022 Unmanned aircraft systems — Part 2: Operation of vertiports for vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) unmanned aircraft (UA)
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 5015-2:2022, an international standard specifying requirements for vertiport operations for VTOL unmanned aircraft and their interface with UAS operators and UTM service providers. It supports compliance demonstration and third-party attestation. Only metadata and scope are shown.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies requirements for vertiport operations (e.g. contaminant removal, noise).
Defines interface with UAS/VTOL operators and UTM service providers.
Usable as acceptable means of compliance with aviation authorities.
Supports third-party attestation of compliance even without applicable regulation.
Excludes UAS operational procedures, vertiport physical characteristics and UTM SP requirements.
